interview_focus: Prepare to explain specific projects built using Python, SQL, or Flask.

ai_recommendations.summary_rewrite: Entry-level developer with foundational knowledge of Python, SQL, and Flask. Seeking to leverage technical fundamentals for junior roles while building practical project experience.
weak_points: Resume contains only a skills list with no work experience, education, or project history.
